blocks.text: Mastering Slack navigation on your Mac

Office managers deal with high volumes of messages every day. Finding the right conversation quickly is the first step to reclaiming your time. Slack has a built-in quick switcher that saves you from clicking through sidebars. Press Command + K to open it. Type the name of the channel or person you need to reach. Press Enter to jump there immediately.

If you are lost in a long thread, use Command + / to open the full list of keyboard shortcuts. This cheat sheet is your best friend for learning how to move around the app without a mouse. You can also [jump to a conversation in Slack](/how-to/jump-to-a-conversation-in-slack) using the same quick switcher method.
Using Lazur to manage your Slack workspace

Lazur lives in the notch of your Mac. When you have a question about where a setting is or how to perform a task, hold Option + Command. Ask Lazur your question. It will look at your screen and give you an answer out loud. If you ask where a specific button is, Lazur will draw a circle around it.
Organizing your day with Slack tips

items: Mute noisy channels: Right-click the channel name in the sidebar and select Mute. This stops notifications for that specific group.
Use threads: Always reply in a thread to keep the main channel clean. This helps everyone track conversations better.
Set your status: Use the profile menu to set your status to Away or In a Meeting. This manages expectations for when you will reply.
Schedule messages: If you have a reminder for the team, use the schedule feature to send it during business hours.
Clear cache: If Slack acts slow, go to Help > Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart.

blocks.text: Writing long updates for the office can take time. Hold the fn key to use Lazur for dictation. It turns your voice into clean, formatted text at the cursor. This is useful for drafting announcements or responding to complex questions in Slack. Speak naturally. Lazur handles the punctuation and formatting for you.
Always review the dictated text before pressing Enter. Even with high accuracy, a quick scan prevents typos in company-wide announcements.
blocks.title: Check your text

blocks.text: Interrupting your work to check Slack every few minutes kills your flow. It takes over 23 minutes to get back into deep work after a distraction. Set up notification schedules in your Slack preferences. Go to Slack > Settings > Notifications to customize your alert times. You can also use the /dnd command to pause notifications for a specific duration.

Searching is a core skill for office managers. Use modifiers to narrow down your results. Type 'from:@name' to find messages by a specific person. Use 'in:#channel' to look within a specific group. These modifiers save you from scrolling through thousands of messages. You can also [search messages in Slack](/how-to/search-messages-in-slack) using the Command + G shortcut.

items: Sending messages to the wrong channel: Double-check the channel name before you press Enter.
Ignoring thread replies: This creates clutter and makes it harder for others to follow the conversation.
Overusing @channel: Use it only for urgent, company-wide announcements to avoid notification fatigue.
Not using search modifiers: Scrolling manually is inefficient when you have tools to filter by date or person.
Leaving all channels active: Mute channels that do not require your immediate attention.

blocks.text: Start by organizing your sidebar. Mute channels you do not need to check daily. Then, practice using the Command + K shortcut for one hour. Once you are comfortable with navigation, use Lazur to help you draft your next office update. You will find that your communication becomes faster and more precise.

faq.question: Can Lazur send Slack messages for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur helps you draft and dictate text into the Slack input field, but you must press Enter to send the message.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with other Mac apps?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur works in any app on your Mac. You can use it to ask questions or dictate text in apps like Notion, Microsoft Word, or your web browser.

faq.question: Is my data safe when using Lazur?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur only listens and looks at your screen while you hold the shortcut. Your audio and screenshots are not stored and are never used to train AI models.

faq.question: What is the best way to learn Slack shortcuts?
faq.answer: Press Command + / inside the Slack desktop app to open the full list of available shortcuts. Practice one or two new ones each day.
